jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will turn product, job market, and user data into actionable insights that improve search, recommendations, and user experience.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities
• Write SQL queries and build recurring reports or dashboards
• Define and monitor key product and business metrics
• Support A/B tests and evaluate the impact of new features
• Investigate data quality issues and improve reporting accuracy
• Present findings clearly to product, engineering, and business stakeholders
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate or graduating soon in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with spreadsheets or Python
• Understanding of basic statistics, data analysis, and experimentation
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work remotely within the United States

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience

jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the job search process into a fast, expert-guided journey. They are seeking an AI Engineer to build and scale business-facing AI agents, managing the entire lifecycle from prototype to production.

Why Join Us

Build real, production AI agents used by real users
High ownership and impact
Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

Integrate yourself directly into client and internal workflows to ensure data-driven insights are a vital part of AI agent analysis and decision-making
Produce custom, timely data reports and visualizations that provide expert analysis for both internal product teams and external clients
Handle data-related requests promptly and satisfactorily, communicating complex findings in an effective, consistent, and professional manner
Report to a manager and work regularly with other members of the team to refine data models and agent performance

Qualification

Required

Recent graduate or entry-level professional with 0–2 years of experience in data analysis or a related technical field
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain data trends to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
A strong knowledge of statistics, data analysis methodologies, and the logical frameworks of AI and machine learning
Must live in and be authorized to work in the United States, with a willingness to travel for occasional team summits if agreed upon

Preferred

Previous internship or project experience as a data analyst, support staffer, or researcher within a tech environment or AI-focused company
Proven experience working with analytics to provide practical and digestible insights gleaned from complex data sets
Technical skills such as coding (Python/R), data modeling, and database management (SQL)

jobs.title: BUSINESS DATA ANALYST | F-1 / OPT / STEM OPT
jobs.description:
🚀 BUSINESS DATA ANALYST | F-1 / OPT / STEM OPT

📍 Location: United States
💼 Job Type: Full-Time
🎓 Visa: F-1 / OPT / STEM OPT

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re connecting with recent Master’s graduates who want to apply their analytical and business skills to real-world data challenges in the U.S.

This opportunity is suitable for candidates with backgrounds in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems, or related fields.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Analyze business data to identify trends and opportunities.
• Develop dashboards and performance reports.
• Track KPIs and business metrics.
• Write SQL queries for data extraction and analysis.
• Perform trend, variance, and root-cause analysis.
• Translate business requirements into data-driven solutions.
• Collaborate with Finance, Product, Operations, and Data teams.
• Present actionable insights to stakeholders.

REQUIRED SKILLS

• SQL
• Excel
• Power BI / Tableau
• Business Analytics
• Data Visualization
• Statistical Analysis
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Python or R
• Snowflake / BigQuery
• Databricks
• Data Warehousing
• ETL / ELT
• Financial Analytics
• Cloud Technologies

EDUCATION

Master’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

VISA ELIGIBILITY

🇺🇸 F-1 / OPT / STEM OPT candidates with valid U.S. work authorization are welcome to connect.

🎓 Recent Master’s graduates currently based in the U.S. are especially encouraged to explore the opportunity.

CANDIDATE SUPPORT

✅ Profile & opportunity alignment
✅ Interview scheduling support
✅ Technical preparation
✅ Hiring-process guidance
✅ Referral support whenever possible
